In [[mathematics]], {{harvs|txt|last=Grothendieck|first=Alexander|authorlink=Alexander Grothendieck|year=1957}} in his "[[Grothendieck's Tôhoku paper|Tôhoku paper]]" introduced a sequence of [[axiom]]s of various kinds of [[category (mathematics)|categories]] [[enriched category|enriched]] over the [[symmetric monoidal category]] of [[abelian group]]s. [[Abelian categories]] are sometimes called '''AB2 categories''', according to the axiom (AB2). '''AB3 categories''' are [[abelian category|abelian categories]] possessing arbitrary [[Coproduct|coproducts]] (hence, by the existence of quotients in abelian categories, also all [[colimit]]s). '''AB5 categories''' are the AB3 categories in which [[filtered colimit]]s of [[exact sequence]]s are exact. [[Grothendieck category|Grothendieck categories]] are the AB5 categories with a [[Generator (category theory)|generator]].
